timeline.labelEn: Christine McVie, British singer and keyboardist of Fleetwood Mac (1943–2022)
timeline.labelDe: Christine McVie, britische Sängerin und Keyboarderin von Fleetwood Mac (1943–2022)

questions.notes: Read as: the band's first female singer — she joined the all-male Fleetwood Mac in 1970, before Stevie Nicks. Earlier she had sung with Chicken Shack, which could also be argued.

timeline.labelEn: Main tower of Ulm Minster completed at 161.53 m
timeline.labelDe: Hauptturm des Ulmer Münsters mit 161,53 m vollendet

questions.notes: Dated premise: since 2025 the Sagrada Família's tower of Jesus Christ is taller; Ulm Minster remains the tallest bell tower.

questions.notes: Edison taught Mina Miller Morse code and used it to propose; they married on 24 February 1886.
